slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
蓝星华国
深夜
海市的明珠塔顶端站立着一个穿着奇异黑色长袍的年轻男人。
他叫郁凡。
现在正常来说已经60岁了，然而实际上自己却不知道已经活了多少年。
没想到自己好不容易修炼至渡劫期，却渡劫失败，原以为可能要身死道消了，再睁眼却回到了自己原来的世界。
郁凡仅仅只是闭眼间，便将周围十公里的信息收入识海。
原来自己穿越到异世界六百年余年，而蓝星却仅仅只过去了四十年。
没想到短短几十年，华国已经有了这么大的变化。
想到如今的自己无亲无故，人生地不熟，郁凡便有些低落。
他从明珠塔上下来，正想着自己要不要去找个山头隐世独居。
却被人包围了。
“先生，你这样实在是太危险了！”几名民警铁青着脸看着郁凡。
这时，郁凡才想到现在的世界已经不再是自己所在的修真界了。
原来是有人看到郁凡站在塔顶一动不动，担心他是想不开想自杀，于是报了警。
然而警察过来时，却正好看到郁凡从上面跳下来。
虽然并未见到郁凡是从接近500米的塔顶跳下来的，但他们的心脏也狠狠的跳了几下。
“把你的身份证拿出来看看。”民警口头教育了一番后，要求郁凡拿出身份证查验身份，毕竟一个看似二十岁的年轻小伙子从高处跳下，怎么也得联系一下家里人，了解一下具体情况。
“身份证？”郁凡有些疑惑，他没听说过这个，“是村里开的身份证明吗？”
民警点头，可郁凡哪儿拿的出身份证明，他曾经的东西早已经不在身边。

民警发现郁凡拿不出证明，只好将他带回警局。
郁凡解释了一番自己现在已经60岁了，因为一直在山头隐居才回到这边所以才不了解现在世界的情况。
但民警并不相信，毕竟一个看似二十岁的小伙子说自己已经花甲之年，想想也不太可能。
从郁凡口中得知他是上清村人，民警调查了一番，震惊的发现，正如郁凡所说，他已经60岁了！
于是一番抽血检验，除了发现郁凡身体的活性细胞比一般人强以外，并未发现其他与他人不同处。
“老人家，你是怎么保养的？”民警再次见到一头长发，俊秀英挺的郁凡时候忍不住脱口而出，这也太厉害了！
“这个，可能山里的空气清新，灵气足，所以人也老的慢？”郁凡无奈的忽悠着。
虽然如今的他只有筑基期修为，但是在这蓝星也可以说是无敌的存在了。
想要摆脱这些小官帽的限制是很轻松的一件事，可毕竟他是经历过华国开放的人，对于这些忠贞爱国的子弟兵，还是非常有好感的。
“是这样的，老人家，您现在没有身份证，可以说算得上是黑户了，我们根据调查，您还有一个儿子在海市，您看你要不要去找他。”
“什么？”郁凡震惊极了，他怎么会有一个儿子？
“不会有错的，我们根据数据库检验到您有一个直系亲属，该直系亲属的母亲是江秋云女士。”
郁凡从自己久远的记忆中找出了那抹倩影，那是在他穿越前交往的前女友。
content_en:
Blue Star China
late at night
At the top of the Pearl Tower in Haishi stood a young man wearing a strange black robe.
His name is Yu Fan.
Normally, I am now 60 years old, but in fact I don’t know how many years I have lived.
Unexpectedly, I finally reached the stage of transcending the tribulation through cultivation, but failed. I thought I might die, but when I opened my eyes, I returned to my original world.
Yu Fan just closed his eyes and absorbed the information from the surrounding ten kilometers into the sea of ​​consciousness.
It turns out that he traveled to another world for more than six hundred years, but only forty years have passed in Blue Star.
Unexpectedly, China has undergone such great changes in just a few decades.
Yu Fan felt a little depressed when he thought that he had no relatives and no familiar place in his life.
He came down from the Pearl Tower and was thinking about whether he should find a mountain top to live alone in seclusion.
But he was surrounded by people.
"Sir, it's too dangerous for you to do this!" Several policemen looked at Yu Fan with livid faces.
At this time, Yu Fan realized that the current world was no longer the world of cultivation he was in.
It turned out that someone saw Yu Fan standing motionless on the top of the tower and was worried that he was thinking about suicide, so he called the police.
However, when the police came over, they saw Yu Fan jumping down from above.
Although they didn't see Yu Fan jumping from the top of the tower that was nearly 500 meters away, their hearts beat a few times.
"Take out your ID card and take a look." After some verbal education, the police officer asked Yu Fan to take out his ID card to check his identity. After all, a young man who seemed to be twenty years old jumped from a high place. He had to contact his family to find out the specific situation.
"ID card?" Yu Fan was a little confused. He had never heard of this. "Is it the ID card issued by the village?"
The policeman nodded, but where could Yu Fan get his identification? The things he once had were no longer with him.
The police found that Yu Fan could not produce proof, so they had to take him back to the police station.
Yu Fan explained that he was 60 years old now. He had been living in seclusion on the top of the mountain before returning here, so he didn't understand the current situation in the world.
But the police didn't believe it. After all, a young man who looked like he was twenty years old said that he was already in his sixties. It was impossible to think about it.
After learning from Yu Fan that he was from Shangqing Village, the police investigated and were shocked to find that, just as Yu Fan said, he was already 60 years old!
So a blood test was conducted, and apart from finding that the active cells in Yu Fan's body were stronger than those of ordinary people, no other differences were found.
"Old man, how do you take care of yourself?" When the police saw the long-haired and handsome Yu Fan again, he couldn't help blurting out, "This is amazing!"
"Well, maybe the air in the mountains is fresh and full of spiritual energy, so people age slowly?" Yu Fan said helplessly.
Although he is only in the foundation-building stage now, he can be said to be invincible in this Blue Star.
It is very easy to get rid of the restrictions of these small official titles, but after all, he is a person who has experienced the opening up of China, and he still has a good impression of these loyal and patriotic soldiers.
"It's like this, old man, you don't have an ID card now, so you can be considered a gangster. According to our investigation, you also have a son in Haishi. Do you want to go find him?"
"What?" Yu Fan was shocked. How could he have a son?
"There is nothing wrong. We have verified based on the database that you have an immediate relative, and the mother of this immediate relative is Ms. Jiang Qiuyun."
Yu Fan found that beautiful figure from his long memory. It was the ex-girlfriend he dated before time travel.
